frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Pompian's two-principle decision rule for biases in asset allocation: moderate (correct) cognitive biases and adapt to emotional biases (Principle II), and moderate biases in less-wealthy clients but adapt to them in wealthier ones (Principle I).
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Moderate vs Adapt to Investor Biases
